prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Make one standalone wooden village bench sprite for a cozy Korean RPG, matched to these reference images.
Image 1 is a reference for muted warm materials, brown outlines and front-facing horizontal projection. Image 2 is the school's shallow front-facing orthographic camera.
Subject: a simple well-made public wooden bench, horizontal seat and low backrest made of only 3 broad wooden slats, two short gray-brown supports/legs. Muted medium warm beige-brown timber, no saturated orange. Calm brown clean outlines, matte fills, restrained soft broad shading. Keep the design simple and grounded. Overall width about 2 times height.
Projection: directly front-facing, vertical legs vertical, all seat/backrest long edges perfectly horizontal. A shallow narrow sliver of seat top is visible. No isometric angle, no diagonal bench, no deep perspective. Same gentle illustration style as reference flowerbed and school, no grain/noise, no photoreal textures.
Full bench isolated and centered with margin on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. No checkerboard image, no floor or cast shadow, no labels, no text, no flowers, no extra props.
processing: Preserve alpha; crop empty margins with 2px padding; bicubic resize to320px width.
